item.title: SCHEDULED/QUEENS, NY– NEWTOWN CREEK /MARINE EVENT/SEC SNY BNM 0542-26
item.description:
1. NARRATIVE: A FILMING EVENT IN NEWTOWN CREEK

2. NEW YORK – GRAND ST BRIDGE – NEWTOWN CREEK - MARINERS ARE ADVISED THAT A FILMING EVENT IS SCHEDULED TO OCCUR FOR TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS FROM OCTOBER 29, 2026, THROUGH OCTOBER 30, 2026, BETWEEN 4:00 P.M. AND 4:00 A.M. EACH DAY. THE FILMING WILL TAKE PLACE IN VICINITY OF THE GRAND STREET BRIDGE OVER NEWTOWN CREEK IN QUEENS, NY. MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO TRANSIT WITH CAUTION WHILE IN THE VICINITY OF THE FILMING EVENT.

item.title: UPDATE/NEW YORK, NY – NEW YORK HARBOR – UPPER BAY – ANCHORAGE 21-A/HAZARD/SEC SNY BNM 0512-26 UPDATE-1
item.description:
1. NARRATIVE: A SUNKEN BARGE WAS REPORTED IN ANCHORAGE 21-A IN NEW YORK HARBOR.
2. AN OPEN HOPPER BARGE SANK IN ANCHORAGE 21-A IN THE UPPER BAY OF NEW YORK HARBOR IN APPROXIMATE POSITION, 40° 39' 35.64"N, 074° 01' 51.42"W. THE BARGE MEASURES 230’ LONG BY 42’ WIDE BY 14’ TALL AND IT SANK IN APPROXIMATELY 13 FEET OF WATER. PORTIONS OF THE BARGE ARE VISIBLE AT LOW TIDE. THE SUNKEN BARGE IS MARKED AT ITS 4 CORNERS BY THREE RED BUOYS AND ONE YELLOW BUOY. A FLOATING WHITE STROBE LIGHT IS ATTACHED TO EACH MARKING BUOY. MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO USE CAUTION WHILE TRANSITING THE AREA.
